parameters.name: jobId
parameters.description: Job ID. You can obtain the job ID through the API at https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/460565.html

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: Organization identity, also known as organization ID, in string format. You can obtain it from the Alibaba Cloud DevOps access link, such as https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】

parameters.name: pipelineId
parameters.description: Pipeline ID. You can obtain it from the pipeline link, such as https://flow.aliyun.com/pipelines/【PipelineId】/current
